detailed_description:
The target video uses live-action photographic realism and the natural lighting of the scene anchor.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement. Preserve the facial identity of <Subject 3> in their scene position. At the beginning, the husband is ALREADY shaved to uniform 1mm stubble from the first frame; the clipper is OFF in his lap. Next, he relaxes his shoulders and meets his wife’s gaze. Toward the end, she gently touches his forearm and they share a restrained smile; scalp stubble stays unchanged. Faces stay clearly focused, natural skin texture and facial proportions remain stable. Wife keeps her headwrap fully on throughout; the clipper belongs only to husband and stays far from wife. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 8.708 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape:
Low room ambience, restrained breathing and soft fabric movements synchronized to the visible action. Phone handling produces only quiet contact sounds; there are no alerts or other voices.

non_diegetic_music:
A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
